... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Raj Kumar,Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Uday Chand Prasad, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 4 12-11-2024 Heard the parties.

2. The petitioner is in judicial custody in connection with Baisi P.S. Case No. 405 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 376 of the IPC lodged on 07.10.2023 by the informant, Most.
Sufri Devi.

3. As per the prosecution story, the informant alleged that while she was sleeping in her court-yard,
the petitioner came, put the curtains down and then on the point of knife committed rape.
As the people started coming, he escaped.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that both are aged persons, blessed with children,
though the lady had made allegation the medical report does not support completely the said allegation.

Further, if granted relief, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.22173 of 2024(4)
dt.12-11-2024 petitioner will be diligently appearing in the trial and will under no circumstance coerce the informant/prosecution witnesses.
5. Learned APP opposes the prayer submitting that the lady has made allegation against this petition of having committed rape.

Taking into account the aforesaid facts as also submissions put forward by the parties, the charge-sheet stands submitted, it has been undertaken by the learned counsel for the petitioner that he will be diligently appearing in the trial and will under no circumstance coerce the informant/prosecution witnesses, has remained in custody since 04.11.2023 (para-4 of the petition)
and has no criminal antecedent, this Court is inclined to extend him the privilege of bail.
